answers.answer: Quote of £605 awaiting landlord approval; provider claims phone approval, unverified. Tenant has vacated, so no tenant message is needed.

answers.answer: Landlord asked for a yes/no by email (APR-102); Sawyer told to wait by email (MSG-103); hold to 2024-10-11.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. This is routine waiting on the landlord. Escalate only if the landlord stays silent after a chase.
